text.title: Does EMA6 reach VWAP before reversing through the pivot?
text.description:
After an actual EMA6–pivot crossing, observe the next 30 minutes for a strict EMA6 crossing through VWAP before a reverse pivot crossing. The at-risk denominator contains resolved or fully observed sequences starting strictly before the other line.

Simultaneous crossings, already-beyond-VWAP starts and incomplete windows remain separate. A tie at a completed close has no inferred intrabar order.
text.finding: EMA6 reached VWAP before recrossing the pivot in 362 of 705 resolved or fully observed at-risk sequences (51.3%), supported by 429 days. Another 20 sequences were censored. Excluded starting configurations remain visible below, so their large count is not silently absorbed into the conditional probability.

text.title: How do cloud states relate to movement after a pivot cross?
text.description:
Compare complete 30-minute EMA6–pivot paths by contemporaneous cloud support, opposition or mixed state. Support requires directional EMA20/50 ordering and both native five-minute 15-minute slopes in the crossing direction; opposition requires the opposite configuration.

States are recorded at the event close. Conditional outcome groups are exploratory and share days with each other.
text.finding: Mean 30-minute directional displacement was -0.31 ES points with cloud support (645 paths), compared with 0.57 points with opposition (393 paths). Mixed states averaged -0.13 points. The observed ordering does not support assuming that the support label automatically improves this outcome; it is an exploratory conditional comparison.
